items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: So I don't even know how Roger Dodge made his living in those late years, not all he did.

ctx.x: It was just amazing, the contrast and styles between the two of them.
So I don't even know how Roger Dodge made his living in those late years, not all he did.
How about E. Sims Campbell? Do you know anything about E. Sims Campbell? He wrote the chapter on blues. I've seen him once. I never did really know him.
